program.name: Backbend Yoga
program.subject: Yoga
program.blurb: An open front body: backbends and hip flexors, then twists and shoulder openers.
program.about: Yoga that opens the front of the body after long days sitting. One day builds toward backbends with low lunges, sphinx, cobra, bridge and camel. The other twists the spine and opens the shoulders. Sun salutations open every session and rest closes it. Level II holds every pose longer and Level III brings deeper versions.
